widgets.name: course-outline
widgets.title: Course outline
widgets.description: The run week by week: the module taught in each week, the meetings scheduled inside it with their dates and rooms, and the assessments that open or fall due there. A week with no module is drawn as unplanned rather than as empty.

widgets.name: class-progress
widgets.title: Class progress grid
widgets.description: Concepts in teaching order against students by pseudonym, with the mean proportion of marks earned on evidence tagged with each. Distinguishes 0% from never assessed.

widgets.name: gradebook
widgets.title: Gradebook
widgets.description: One score per student per assessment from approved decisions, with the rows that must not be exported and the reason for each.

widgets.name: action-inbox
widgets.title: Professor's inbox
widgets.description: Grades awaiting approval, outstanding submissions, open signals and interventions waiting on the professor for one run.
